prompt_rules: Freeform bodies (family csg): when silhouette, revolve or blob cannot make the product form (wedge consoles, stepped organisers, upright towers, flat base stations, docks with trays or grooves), write "body": {"family": "csg", "csg": <node>, "wall": 2.4, "split": "base_plate", "feet": 4, "edge_round": 0}. The csg tree is the OUTER form only, as JSON data (no code); the engine hollows it, adds the seam, the core cartridge, the module mounts and runs every check.
csg frame: mm, +z up, the object stands on z = 0, the FRONT faces -y, +x is the viewer's right. Everything below z = 0 is cut off: give it a flat base on z = 0 (footprint at least 15 cm2).

csg primitives: {"op":"box","size":[sx,sy,sz],"round":r} centred on x and y, rising from z = 0; {"op":"cylinder","r":R,"h":H,"round":r} axis +z from z = 0; {"op":"cone","r1":R1,"r2":R2,"h":H} radius r1 at z = 0, r2 at z = H; {"op":"sphere","r":R} and {"op":"torus","R":R,"r":r} (a ring around the z axis) centred on their origin; {"op":"extrude","points":[[a,b],...],"h":H,"axis":"z","round":r}: axis z = top-view points [x,y] rising from z = 0, axis y = FRONT-view points [x,z] extruded along y from -H/2 to H/2, axis x = SIDE-view points [y,z] (front = -y) extruded along x from -H/2 to H/2; {"op":"revolve","points":[[r,z],...]} a closed profile (r >= 0) turned about the z axis. round = edge radius in mm (default 0).

csg combinators: {"op":"move","to":[x,y,z],"rot":[rx,ry,rz],"node":N} turns N about its own origin (degrees: first about x, then y, then z) and then shifts it; {"op":"union","nodes":[...],"blend":b} joins pieces (blend = fillet radius where they meet); {"op":"cut","node":N,"minus":[...]} carves trays, grooves, pen cups, slots and recesses (they stay walled off from the electronics); {"op":"intersect","nodes":[...]} keeps only the common part. Any node may carry a short "name"; errors quote it.

csg limits: at most 40 nodes and 8 levels of nesting; outlines 3-64 points, at least 1 mm apart, not crossing, first point not repeated; every size at least 2 mm (radii at least 1); positions |x|, |y| <= 130 and z <= 260. The result must be ONE solid (pieces must overlap, not just touch), no part thinner than 2 mm, and it must still hold the core cartridge and each module's depth behind its face (the fit rules).

csg hollow: pieces that should share the inside (a pod on a base, a step on a step) must overlap the main body by at least 6 mm; a piece whose hollow does not join the main hollow prints solid and nothing can mount behind its faces. Features keep their faces (front and rear [x,z], left and right [y,z], top [x,y]); on a sloped face the module sits square to the slope.
